Subject: Quickstart docs -> Request for technical demo

Hi Marissa,

I just followed the Quickstart docs and got a prototype calling the API. Really impressed with the latency and the dev experience. I wanted to see if we could schedule a short technical demo focused on:
- model selection and recommended quantization for our use (multi-tenant analytics)
- batching / caching best practices for short queries
- integration tips for KV cache and session routing

My team (Tom Lee, cc'd) would like a 30–45 minute slot next week. Our timezone is PST. Do you have any availability? Also open to a recorded walkthrough if that helps.

Thanks,

I can definitely run a technical demo and focus on those points. I have the following 30-min slots next week (PST):
- Tue 2026-03-24 10:00–10:30
- Wed 2026-03-25 14:00–14:30
- Thu 2026-03-26 09:30–10:00

If none of those work, feel free to pick a time via our scheduling page: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-demo
